s: Today we are talking about simple cooking at home.
Do you cook every day, Maya?
I try to cook every day.
Yesterday I made soup, and today I will make soup again.
What is your plan for today?
Do you have a good recipe for the soup?
I found a simple recipe online.
The recipe has only five steps.
A simple recipe is the best.
What ingredients does your recipe need?
The recipe needs water, carrots, onions, potatoes, and salt.
Cheap ingredients are great for a student.
Then I put the vegetables in the hot water.
Do you boil the water first?
Boil the water for two minutes, then add the vegetables.
I boil the water, add the vegetables, and cook for twenty minutes.
I also like to fry food.
Do you fry the eggs with butter or oil?
I fry them with a little oil.
I fry the eggs for three minutes, and they taste wonderful.
I will fry some eggs tomorrow morning for breakfast.
Now, let me tell you about my favorite recipe.
You must chop everything very small.
I am not good at chopping.
When you chop vegetables, use a sharp knife and be careful.
I will chop more carefully next time.
After we chop, what do we do?
After we chop the vegetables, we boil the water for the pasta.
You cannot make pasta if you do not boil the water.
While the water boils, peel the tomatoes.
You need to peel them for the sauce.
First you peel the tomato, then you chop it.
Ha ha, that is a good rule: peel, chop, and cook!
Stir it slowly for ten minutes.
When I stir, I always taste it.
Taste the sauce and tell me: is it good?
Hmm, it tastes a little salty.
Add some water and stir again.
I will stir in some water.
Now let me taste it again.
Taste is important when you cook.
Always taste your food before you serve it.
My grandmother had a recipe for bread.
She would bake bread every Saturday.
I want to bake too, but I am afraid.
You mix every ingredient together, and you bake for thirty minutes.
What ingredients do you need to bake bread?
I will try to bake bread this weekend.
I have the recipe, and I have every ingredient I need.
When you bake, your kitchen smells amazing.
The smell of fresh bread is the best.
So, let us review our cooking words.
We have recipe: the steps for a dish.
And ingredient: something you use to make food.
Boil: heat water until it bubbles.
We used all ten words today in our kitchen talk.
I will chop, and you will stir.
And we will taste the food at the end.
See you next time on Word Kitchen!
